name: Claude Code
verdict: A top-tier terminal coding agent that comes bundled with Claude plans; heavy users will want Max.

pricing.price: From $100/mo (5x or 20x more usage than Pro)

cons: No free tier for Claude Code
pricingNote: On 2026-10-14 claude.com/pricing showed Pro at $17 per month with annual billing ($200 up front) or $20 billed monthly, and Max from $100 per month. The Max card says to choose 5x or 20x more usage than Pro, and that Max includes $100 to $200 a month in API credits. It does not list a separate Max 20x subscription price, so none is shown.
